newsitem.title: USA: EnviroSource Inc Q4 net, shr fall.
newsitem.headline: EnviroSource Inc Q4 net, shr fall.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1996 $4.4 million deferred income tax benefit arose from recognizing deferred tax assets in balance sheet. The benefit exceeded the amounts otherwise applicable to pre-tax losses by $3.1 million, or $0.08 per share, for the year, and $3.9 million, or $0.10 per share, in the quarter.

Unusual items 1996 consisted of charges in first three quarters for 1996 reorganization, office relocations and settlement of disputed matter for 1993 restructuring, and a Q4 credit from cutting estimated liabilities remaining from 1988 acquisition of IU International. After taxes unusual items came to $3 million or $0.08 per share of loss for the year and added $600,000 or $0.01 per share to 1996 Q4.

1995 unusual items (net credits from IU International acquisition partially offset by employee termination and restructuring charges) increased income before taxes. Favorable impact offset by increase in deferred income tax expense. Thus, after taxes unusual items cut income by about $1 million or $0.02 per share for the year and $1.5 milion or $0.04 per share in 1995 Q4.
